facts.content: User prefers dark mode in all interfaces.
Default stack is FastAPI + PostgreSQL for backend services.
All API endpoints must return consistent JSON with status field.
Docker Compose is the preferred local development environment.
Production deploys on Ubuntu 22.04 EC2 instances.
All environment variables must be documented in .env.example.
Test coverage must remain above 80% before any merge.
Neo4j is the primary knowledge graph store.
DeepSeek Flash is preferred for cost-effective LLM calls.
MIT License applies to all open-source contributions.
